title: 외래어 1: 음식·음료 — 메뉴판의 커피, 피자, 햄버거
objective: Read menu loanwords aloud and know which English sounds became ㅍ, ㅋ, ㅓ, and an extra ㅡ.
summary: Read and pronounce food and drink loanwords like 커피, 피자, and 햄버거.

task.title: Read the menu words
task.line: Use the four rules on page 1 to read, spell, and match each word.

letters.sound: [pʰ] — used for both English p and f: 피자, 커피
letters.as: p in 'pie', with a strong puff of air

letters.sound: [kʰ] — used for English k or hard c: 커피, 케이크
letters.as: k in 'kite', with a strong puff of air

letters.sound: [ʌ] — used for English 'er' and short 'o': 햄버거, 커피
An English final consonant often gets an extra [ㅡ]: 주스, 케이크

exercises: Read each word and write the English food it comes from: ① 토마토 ② 바나나 ③ 치즈
Fill in the blank with one syllable: ① ____스타 (pasta) ② 와____ (waffle) ③ ____클 (pickle)
Choose the correct spelling: ① 쿠키 / 구기 (cookie) ② 치킨 / 지긴 (chicken) ③ 토스트 / 토스 (toast)
Read each word aloud, then write it in Revised Romanization: ① 아이스크림 ② 샌드위치 ③ 도넛
answers: ① tomato ② banana ③ cheese
① 파 ② 플 ③ 피
① 쿠키 ② 치킨 ③ 토스트
① aiseukeurim ② saendeuwichi ③ doneot
